task: Draft a title, x-axis label, y-axis label, and brief caption for a line chart in a fictional publisher's annual report. Use the supplied revenue figures only; do not add trend interpretations, multi-year comparisons, or projections beyond the supplied data range.

facts.text: The chart shows monthly revenue for Meridian Press for the 12 months of 2023.
The x-axis represents months from January to December 2023.
The y-axis represents revenue in thousands of GBP (£k).
Revenue ranged from a low of £42,000 in January to a high of £98,000 in December.
The data is the complete annual set for 2023; no multi-year comparison data is included.
